## Houston 0.6.17

### Updates that wait for you

- **Houston no longer restarts itself to update.** A new version downloads quietly in the background, and a small "Restart to update" button appears in the corner of the window. Restart whenever you like; nothing you are doing gets interrupted.
- **Your agent finishes what it is doing before it restarts**, so a task in progress is never cut off by an update.
- **A message sent while your agent is restarting is delivered once it is back**, instead of failing.

### Calmer, more honest messages

- **Everyday moments no longer look like failures**, so a waking agent, an expired sign-in, or a permission you do not have shows a clear notice instead of a red error.

### Sign-in fixes

- **Signing in with Claude on Windows now works on more setups.**
- **A Claude subscription stays connected on self-hosted setups.**
- **When your ChatGPT sign-in expires, Houston asks you to sign in again** instead of showing an error.

### Fixes and polish

- **The integrations catalog now shows every available app**, instead of stopping partway through the list.
- **Houston only offers models your connected provider can actually run.**
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.
